Callout.Name: Withdrawal
Callout.Message: Person shaking and vomiting, withdrawing from something.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, no injuries, refuses to say what.

Script.Line: Third day. It is always the third day.
I am not going to hospital. They will only do the same thing again.
I have done it before. I can do it again. I just need to get through tonight.

Callout.Patient: I just need to get through it. I have done it before.

Lines.Approach: Shaking, sick, and not saying what they have been taking. Keep your kit close.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
